name: Ensures Compliance to Highest Standards of Care to Patients - Dr Shamsh Kassim-Lakha

content.title: Ensures Compliance to Highest Standards of Care to Patients - Dr Shamsh Kassim-Lakha
content.summary: Six areas of the Aga Khan University Hospital (AKUH) - Nursing Services Division, Clinical Laboratories, Pharmacy, Neurophysiology, Purchase and Bio-Medical Engineering - have met the requirements of the ISO 9002 Quality System.

media.alt: Ensures Compliance to Highest Standards of Care to Patients - Dr Shamsh Kassim-Lakha

content.text: Six areas of the Aga Khan University Hospital (AKUH) - Nursing Services Division, Clinical Laboratories, Pharmacy, Neurophysiology, Purchase and Bio-Medical Engineering - have met the requirements of the ISO 9002 Quality System. The two-day audit was carried out in February 1999 by a team of five auditors from AIB Vincotte of Belgium. The auditors were impressed with AKUH's systems in these areas as well as the general level of compliance with all the written policies and procedures.

At the certificate presentation ceremony, Dr Shamsh Kassim-Lakha, President of AKU, said "It is most important that we deliver quality care to our patients and the ISO process will continue to be useful in ensuring compliance to the highest standards of care that we have set for ourselves".

"The ISO 9002 journey began in November 1997", said Mr Nadeem Mustafa Khan, Chief Operating Officer of AKUH, "and culminated with the final audit in February 1999. It was all hard work on the part of the staff. We were well-assisted by Mr 1mran Shariff of the Pakistan Institute of Quality Control (PIQC), who provided valuable on-going guidance".

"Continued focus on providing care and services in accordance with the patient's needs is a must for AKUH", informed Mr John B. Stevens, Director General of the Hospital. He further stressed that it is AKUH's intention to prepare the entire Hospital for an ISO 9002 certification in the year 2000.
